# Find Christian Schools — llms.txt

> A searchable directory of Christian schools, colleges, races, jobs, and events.
> Every listing aligns with a Christian Statement of Faith.

## About

Find Christian Schools (findchristianschools.com) is a directory helping families
find faith-based education. It lists 9,000+ Christian schools across all 50 US
states, plus Christian colleges, Christian running races, Christian education
job openings, and Christian education events.

All organizations listed affirm the site's Statement of Faith. Inclusion in the
directory does not constitute endorsement.

## Key URLs

- Homepage / search: https://www.findchristianschools.com/
- Browse by state: https://www.findchristianschools.com/states
- School detail pages: https://www.findchristianschools.com/school/{slug}
- City landing pages: https://www.findchristianschools.com/city/{STATE}/{city-slug}
- Christian colleges: https://www.findchristianschools.com/colleges
- College detail pages: https://www.findchristianschools.com/college/{slug}
- Christian races: https://www.findchristianschools.com/races
- Race detail pages: https://www.findchristianschools.com/race/{slug}
- Christian education jobs: https://www.findchristianschools.com/jobs
- Christian education events: https://www.findchristianschools.com/events
- Submit a school: https://www.findchristianschools.com/submit-school
- Statement of Faith: https://www.findchristianschools.com/statement-of-faith
- Sitemap: https://www.findchristianschools.com/sitemap.xml

## Highest-value factual pages

- Federal Scholarship Tax Credit (FSTC / Education Freedom Tax Credit):
  https://www.findchristianschools.com/federal-tax-credit
  Verified facts: signed into law July 4, 2025; takes effect January 1, 2027;
  taxpayers can donate up to $1,700 per year to Scholarship Granting
  Organizations (SGOs) for a dollar-for-dollar federal tax credit; 30 states
  participate as of October 2026 per the IRS (Arizona does not); includes an
  FAQ and the full participating-state directory.
- Classical Christian schools:
  https://www.findchristianschools.com/classical-christian-schools
- Teacher resources and free classroom tools (worksheets, flashcards,
  lesson planner): https://www.findchristianschools.com/teacher-resources
- Teacher resource blog: https://www.findchristianschools.com/blog
- Christian education news: https://www.findchristianschools.com/news

## Data sources

- School listings: compiled from public records; sources attributed on each listing.
- College listings: U.S. Department of Education IPEDS institutional data (public use).
- Race listings: RunSignup public API (facts only: name, date, location, signup link).

## Listing management

Organizations may claim, correct, or request removal of their listing via the
"Claim this listing" and "Report inaccurate info" links on every detail page.
